description: Change the user's To-do backlog: edit a task, tick it off, move it to another list, or take it out. Every operation names a task by the id from mnemosyne_todo_list, so call that first. Removing a task archives it by default, and it can be restored. Pass permanent: true only when the user asked for it to be deleted outright. The whole batch is applied in order as one save, and each operation reports its own outcome, so a stale id does not sink the ones around it. Works with the app closed on a dev install (the headless daemon reads the file); an npm install has no daemon and needs the app running. Scope todo:write.

ops.description: The changes, applied in order. Up to 100 per call.

color.description: edit: hex colour, or null to clear.

description.description: edit: new notes. null clears them; omitting leaves them alone.

done.description: complete: true ticks it, false re-opens it. Ticking records the human's streak; un-ticking never takes it back.

dueAt.description: edit: due date as epoch milliseconds. null clears it.

group.description: edit: the STEP heading this task sits under. null removes it.

list.description: move: the destination list, by displayed name or key.

op.description: edit = rewrite text/description/colour/step/due date. complete = tick or un-tick. move = send to another list. remove = archive it, or delete it with permanent: true.

permanent.description: remove: true DELETES the task outright, and it is not in the archive afterwards. Default false = archived, recoverable. Only pass true when the human asked to delete rather than to tidy away.

task.description: The task id, exactly as mnemosyne_todo_list printed it in brackets.

text.description: edit: the new text. Omit to leave it alone; it can never be emptied.

name: mnemosyne_todo_update
